name: National Liberation Movements in the Colonies
overview: Manchu dynasty was unsuccessful in defending the interests of China from the western colonial powers. Even independent countries like China were actually under the control of many colonial powers and independent only in name. These powers had become very powerful and influential in different parts of China.

saq.question: Explain Chinese and Manchu with reference to National Liberation Movements in the Colonies.
saq.answer: China: Two Different Phases At the beginning of the 20th century, China was ruled by emperors of Manchu dynasty. Manchu dynasty was unsuccessful in defending the interests of China from the western colonial powers. These powers had become very powerful and influential in different parts of China. They had also forced the emperors to give them economic and political concessions like low import taxes, immunity from Chinese laws, maintaining armed forces, etc. The common people as well as the administrators of the empire were unhappy with this. The administrators tried to reform the systems.
